description: Point links at other files: relink one link to a file or a web URL, relink links to files of the same name in a folder (optionally searching subfolders or with another extension), relink to the same names with another extension, or copy the linked files to a folder and relink to the copies (Links panel menu > Relink, Relink to Folder, Relink File Extension, Copy Link(s) To)

extension.description: The extension to relink to, such as "psd" (mode extension; in mode folder, match the same name with this extension)

folder.description: The folder (modes folder and copy_to_folder; created for copy_to_folder if missing)

links.description: Which links to act on (rows of the Links panel): link ids or names from list_document_links, the page items whose placed content is linked, the links of the selected items, or every link; status narrows the choice

itemIds.description: Page item ids: the links of the graphics or text placed in these frames

names.description: Link names as the Links panel shows them (every link with each name)

selection.description: The links of the selected items

status.description: Keep only links with these statuses; given alone it chooses among every link

mode.description: file: one link to filePath; url: one link to a web URL; folder: same names in folder; extension: same names with another extension beside the original; copy_to_folder: copy files into folder and relink

searchSubfolders.description: Also look in subfolders of folder (mode folder)

url.description: An http or https URL (mode url)

name: relink_document_links
title: Relink Document Links
